text: {"action":"final","fix":["trip_adapter","station_join"],"retrain":false,"reason":"The accuracy loss is primarily caused by stale schema and station-handling logic: trip_adapter fails to map the post-2020 trip layout and station_join fails on dockless/alphanumeric station records, producing widespread missing coordinates, distance, round-trip, and bike features; retraining should wait until the pipeline is repaired."}
